common: Use case: illustration-story. Finished ORIGINAL landscape painting for Dreamerie, a beautiful surreal spot-the-difference game. Image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its textured gouache, visible brushwork on paper, rich luminous colors, elegant storybook whimsy and crisp inspectable detail. Create a new coherent dreamlike scene, not a replica. Full-bleed single 16:9 landscape painting, native 1672x941 or larger same ratio. No words, numbers, labels, borders, watermarks, UI or photorealism. Keep named props separate and clearly readable, away from edges. Render one original image, not a pair.

originals.valentines: Valentine's Day: two swans exchanging tiny letters on a rose-petal canal beneath an enormous flowering heart-shaped willow, sunset rose, ivory and deep peacock blue. A pearl-white swan wears a clear CRIMSON neck ribbon; a black swan carries a cream envelope with a BLUE HEART wax seal. At left foreground a brass mailbox on a little floating island has a HEART-shaped slot. At right a pink porcelain teacup sits on a lily leaf with a visibly SCALLOPED rim. Over the canal hangs one paper lantern decorated with THREE small gold hearts. Tiny dreamy bridges and paper letter boats recede, lyrical affection without greeting-card text.
originals.st-patricks: St. Patrick's Day: a gentle otter in a forest-green waistcoat sits beneath a giant shamrock beside a mossy stone wishing well, playing a little golden harp while a rainbow flows like a ribbon through emerald hills. A large copper kettle in foreground left bears a raised THREE-leaf shamrock emblem. The well arch has a small ROUND blue inset jewel. A wooden bucket at right has THREE horizontal brass bands. Otter wears a visible golden SQUARE belt buckle. A small snail on foreground mushroom has a SPIRAL shell. Mist, tiny cottages, primrose and green/gold/cool violet, Irish spring enchantment without alcohol, stereotypes, flags or writing.
originals.independence: July Fourth: a tiny mouse astronomer on a red-white-blue striped sailboat watches fireworks turn into glowing sea flowers above a fantastical harbor. A large navy sail has a WHITE FIVE-POINT STAR. In foreground left a bronze telescope stands on a wooden pier, its round lens glass BLUE. At right a porcelain picnic pitcher has a LOOP handle. The mouse wears a RED triangular neckerchief. On pier foreground a blue picnic plate holds a single star-shaped biscuit with THREE round sugar dots. Rich sapphire and coral evening, gold fireworks reflected in indigo water, festive magical American summer without writing, actual flags, weapons or mass crowds.
originals.new-years: New Year's Day: a brilliant kingfisher carries a golden key toward a giant open door standing on the dawn sea, a tender hopeful new beginning. A small rowboat carries a potted snowdrop and a BLUE square sail. At left a ceramic sunrise-colored jug has THREE painted wave stripes. At right a small wooden clock without numerals has TWO brass bells above it. The kingfisher's key has a STAR-shaped bow. A pale paper boat foreground has a single RED circular seal. Mint, apricot, pale turquoise and luminous saffron dawn, symbolic beautiful surrealism, no date or writing.
originals.new-years-eve: New Year's Eve: a velvet-blue whale floats over a moonlit rooftop ballroom carrying a delicate brass clock tower on its back, with miniature lanterns and swirling confetti that become constellations. Foreground rooftop has a tall candle in a glass holder with a broad PURPLE ribbon. At left a silver pocket watch has a CRESCENT engraving on its closed lid. At right a midnight-blue party hat bears THREE golden diamond motifs. A little owl wears a GREEN bow tie. A bright golden crescent moon hangs alone at upper left. Magenta, midnight, silver, champagne gold, sophisticated playful dream, no clock numerals, text or alcohol.
originals.easter: Easter: a white rabbit painter transforms enormous eggs into tiny spring worlds in a flowering meadow, one open eggshell holds a miniature orchard and waterfall. At left a large lavender egg bears a broad GOLD zigzag stripe. A small pink egg foreground has THREE blue polka dots. A pale blue watering can to right has a ROUND rose spout with visible holes. The rabbit wears a mint vest with ONE large round PINK button. A perched butterfly near upper right has TWO orange spots on the visible blue wing. Pastel lilac, vivid spring green, butter yellow, blue, warm sunshine; intricate painterly fantasy, no text or religious caricature.
originals.mothers: Mother's Day: a mother deer and fawn resting in a floating garden nest carried by magnolia petals, a crescent cradle holds tiny stars above a lilac pond. Mother wears a delicate CORAL flower behind her ear. At left a large cream teapot has a HEART finial on the lid. At right a nest-like woven basket has TWO green apples. A pink cushion in foreground bears THREE tiny embroidered stars. A small gold music box has a ROUND keyhole. Tender caring, sage, rose, ivory and mauve, gentle original painterly family scene, not greeting-card typography.
originals.fathers: Father's Day: a large bear and a bear cub build a kite shaped like a tiny sailing ship in a workshop floating above blue mountains, the adult helping patiently. The large kite's sail is sunny YELLOW. The cub wears a PURPLE scarf. On the foreground workbench a brass compass has a STAR motif in its lid. A turquoise toolbox at left has TWO gold latches. At right a striped ceramic mug has a SQUARE handle. Cloud woodshavings and a gentle paper windmill, cobalt, terracotta and golden hour, whimsical care and craftsmanship, no writing.
originals.mlk: Martin Luther King Jr. Day: a beautiful symbolic dream of inclusion, an arched bridge woven from luminous ribbons joins two floating gardens; diverse small woodland animals peacefully carry lanterns across toward a golden dawn. One white dove near upper left carries an OLIVE twig with THREE leaves. In left foreground a lantern has a large HEART window. A deep BLUE ribbon forms a prominent bow on the bridge rail. A small round stone planter at right has a STAR carving. Foreground a little open book has a single CRIMSON bookmark. Quiet hopeful dignity, coral, lavender, olive and gold, no historical reenactment, slogans, portraits or text.
originals.presidents: Presidents' Day: an owl librarian in a navy velvet waistcoat tends a floating library of white columns above the clouds, its staircase made of closed books; gentle laurel branches curl through the architecture. A prominent golden QUILL stands in a blue inkwell at left. At right a small red wooden book chest has a STAR-shaped brass keyhole. The owl's waistcoat bears THREE round gold buttons. A large round medallion on the central white column has an OAK LEAF relief. A folded parchment on foreground desk is tied with a BLUE ribbon. Cream, red, navy and sunrise gold, dignified civic learning dream, no text or politician likenesses.
originals.memorial: Memorial Day: a contemplative garden of red poppies and quiet lanterns on floating stepping stones over still blue water at dawn. One empty worn wooden chair holds a folded IVORY blanket, and a gentle white dove rests nearby. At left a large brass lantern has a CRESCENT cutout. At right a blue ceramic vase has TWO loop handles and holds wildflowers. Foreground a small wreath is tied with a BURGUNDY bow. A little round stone by the chair bears THREE carved dots. Tender reflective remembrance, restrained blue, red, ivory and warm sunrise, no party, weapons, battle, graves, text, uniforms or caricature.
originals.juneteenth: Juneteenth: a joyful storybook Black mother and child in simple summer clothes tending a garden beyond an enormous open wrought-iron gate; flowering vines turn into birds against a clear dawn sky, freedom and new possibilities. Left foreground picnic basket holds a large RED cloth with a single WHITE STAR embroidered on it. Mother wears a blue dress with a visible GOLD FLOWER brooch. Child holds a small yellow pinwheel with FOUR broad petals. At right a cobalt jug has THREE narrow white stripes. Gate's upper arch has a round SUN medallion. Rich warm earth, red, blue, white and bright greens, tasteful textured gouache matching reference, human faces simplified painterly not photorealistic. No shackles, slavery imagery, writing, stereotypes or reenactment.
originals.labor: Labor Day: two friendly beavers in work aprons carefully mend a silver crescent moon at a floating carpentry workshop while a tiny village rests below. One big wooden gear in left foreground has a STAR-shaped center hole. A RED work apron has THREE round brass buttons. A teal tool chest at right has a HEART-shaped handle. On a bench in foreground a wooden mallet has TWO dark stripes on its head. A small blue enamel kettle has a ROUND lid knob. Copper, teal, silver and warm amber light, respectful joyful tribute to care and craft, painterly whimsical floating sawdust and wood, no slogans or words.
originals.october-observance: A contemplative October dream for Indigenous Peoples' Day / Columbus Day, centered on the enduring land rather than historical reenactment: a magnificent ancient cedar's roots cradle a whole miniature river valley, salmon leap through streams that curl into clouds, a raven rests on a mossy root. Upper left a clear full moon is PALE GOLD. The raven holds a small RED autumn leaf. In foreground a large copper-colored maple leaf has THREE circular dew drops. At right a hollow round moss-covered stone has a HEART-shaped opening. Near left foreground a small cream wildflower has SIX distinct petals. Cedar green, river turquoise, russet and indigo, reverent natural surrealism. No people, costumes, sacred motifs, pseudo-Indigenous patterns, ships, colonial imagery, writing or stereotyped props.
originals.veterans: Veterans Day: a gentle elderly bear in a plain NAVY coat returns to a warm lantern-lit cottage built inside a giant seashell, welcomed by a cub on the doorstep. Calm dignity and homecoming, no battle. The coat has TWO round brass buttons and a small silver STAR brooch on its lapel. At left foreground a worn brown suitcase bears a single GREEN diamond patch. At right a porch lantern has a large CRESCENT window. A cream welcome teacup on a little table has a BLUE handle. A red poppy grows by the winding path. Indigo, warm honey, muted red and sage, storybook gouache, no weapons, military insignia, writing, gravestones or caricature.
